legend: You are currently taking the course AlgoHell and have procrastinated a bit too much. Today is already the deadline for the current problem. Luckily, you have an algorithm which is correct, but it has a terrible runtime complexity. Therefore, you break into ETH's top secret super computer in the dome at the top of HG. Unfortunately, the complexity of your algorithm is so bad that even on the super computer, it runs too slowly. It will not be able to give you the result in time for your deadline.

To speed up the computation, you need to cool down the super computer. It has n$$$n$$$ different server racks, where n$$$n$$$ is even since the server architects can only buy racks in bundles of 2. Each rack has a unique heat level ai$$$a_i$$$ since your parallelization does not split up the workload evenly. The racks are all aligned in a row; rack i$$$i$$$ is next to rack i+1$$$i+1$$$. You want adjacent racks with a low heat level to cool their warmer neighbors. This works best if the difference between the heat levels is big. Therefore, you want to maximize the sum of absolute differences of heat levels in adjacent server racks:

Since you have been here before, you know that all adjacent racks are connected with a wire. You can use this wire to transfer the workloads and swap the heat levels of one server rack with an adjacent one. However, you also want to minimize the number of swaps, since each swap takes about 1 minute and you have to submit the answer before the deadline.
Now you want to answer 2 questions to determine whether the computation will finish in time:
How much cooling can you achieve — what is the maximum sum of absolute differences in heat levels?
How much time does it take to reach this cooling efficiency — what is the minimum number of adjacent swaps to reach this sum?
input: The first line of input contains an integer t$$$t$$$ (1≤t≤2⋅105$$$1 \leq t \leq 2 \cdot 10^5$$$) — the number of test cases. Then t$$$t$$$ lines follow, each describing one test case.

The first line of each test case contains an integer n$$$n$$$ (2≤n≤4⋅105$$$2 \leq n \leq 4 \cdot 10^5$$$) — the number of server racks in the super computer. Since the server architects are not weird, n$$$n$$$ is guaranteed to be even.
The second line of each test case contains n distinct integers a1,...,an$$$a_1,...,a_n$$$ (1≤ai≤n$$$1 \leq a_i \leq n$$$), where ai$$$a_i$$$ is the heat level of the i$$$i$$$–th rack.
It is guaranteed that the sum of n$$$n$$$ over all test cases does not exceed 4⋅105$$$4 \cdot 10^5$$$.
output: For each test case, output two integers: the maximum sum of absolute differences in heat levels and the minimum number of adjacent swaps required to achieve this maximum.
note: In the first test case, no workloads need to be swapped to reach the maximum difference of 1=|1−2|$$$1 = |1 - 2|$$$.

In the second test case, you can swap heat level 3$$$3$$$ to the very left. After 4 swaps, you have the heating configuration 3,6,5,1,4,2$$$3, 6, 5, 1, 4, 2$$$. Then you can swap 4$$$4$$$ with 2$$$2$$$ and 5$$$5$$$ with 1$$$1$$$, leaving 3,6,1,5,2,4$$$3, 6, 1, 5, 2, 4$$$. This permutation has a maximum sum of differences of 3+5+4+3+2=17$$$3 + 5 + 4 + 3 + 2 = 17$$$ after only 6 swaps. It can be proven that this is the maximum sum and the minimum number of adjacent swaps.

legend.ai: 你目前正在学习 AlgoHell 课程，而且拖延得有些过头了。今天已经是当前题目的截止日期。幸运的是，你有一个正确的算法，但它的时间复杂度非常糟糕。因此，你闯入了 HG 顶部穹顶中的 ETH 顶级机密超级计算机。不幸的是，你的算法复杂度实在太差，即使在超级计算机上运行也太慢了。它无法在截止时间前给出结果。

为了加快计算，你需要给超级计算机降温。它有 n$$$n$$$ 个不同的服务器机架，其中 n$$$n$$$ 是偶数，因为服务器架构师只能以 2 个为一组购买机架。由于你的并行化没有均匀地分配工作负载，每个机架都有唯一的热度 ai$$$a_i$$$。所有机架排成一行；机架 i$$$i$$$ 与机架 i+1$$$i+1$$$ 相邻。你希望热度较低的相邻机架为热度较高的机架降温。热度差越大，降温效果越好。因此，你希望最大化相邻服务器机架热度绝对差之和：
由于你以前来过这里，你知道所有相邻机架之间都连接着一根电线。你可以利用这根电线传输工作负载，并交换一个服务器机架与其相邻机架的热度。然而，你还希望最小化交换次数，因为每次交换大约需要 1 分钟，而你必须在截止时间前提交答案。
现在你想回答 2 个问题，以判断计算能否及时完成：
你最多能实现多少降温效果，也就是热度绝对差之和的最大值是多少？
达到这种冷却效率需要多少时间？也就是说，达到这个总和所需的最少相邻交换次数是多少？

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含一个整数 t$$$t$$$ (1≤t≤2⋅105$$$1 \leq t \leq 2 \cdot 10^5$$$)，表示测试用例的数量。接下来有 t$$$t$$$ 行，每行描述一个测试用例。
每个测试用例的第一行包含一个整数 n$$$n$$$ (2≤n≤4⋅105$$$2 \leq n \leq 4 \cdot 10^5$$$)，表示超级计算机中的服务器机架数量。由于服务器架构师并不奇怪，保证 n$$$n$$$ 为偶数。
每个测试用例的第二行包含 n 个互不相同的整数 a1,...,an$$$a_1,...,a_n$$$ (1≤ai≤n$$$1 \leq a_i \leq n$$$)，其中 ai$$$a_i$$$ 表示第 i$$$i$$$ 个机架的热量等级。
保证所有测试用例的 n$$$n$$$ 之和不超过 4⋅105$$$4 \cdot 10^5$$$。

output.ai: 对于每个测试用例，输出两个整数：热量等级绝对差之和的最大值，以及达到该最大值所需的最少相邻交换次数。

note.ai: 在第一个测试用例中，无需交换任何工作负载即可达到最大差值 1=|1−2|$$$1 = |1 - 2|$$$。

在第二个测试用例中，可以将热度等级 3$$$3$$$ 交换到最左侧。经过 4 次交换后，得到加热配置 3,6,5,1,4,2$$$3, 6, 5, 1, 4, 2$$$。然后可以将 4$$$4$$$ 与 2$$$2$$$ 交换，并将 5$$$5$$$ 与 1$$$1$$$ 交换，得到 3,6,1,5,2,4$$$3, 6, 1, 5, 2, 4$$$。仅经过 6 次交换后，该排列的差值总和最大，为 3+5+4+3+2=17$$$3 + 5 + 4 + 3 + 2 = 17$$$。可以证明，这是最大的差值总和以及达到该总和所需的最少相邻交换次数。
